+class ChartDatasourceFilter(BaseFilter):  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
+    """Match a chart's datasource by both type and ID."""
+
+    name: ClassVar[str] = _("Datasource")
+    arg_name: ClassVar[str] = "chart_datasource"
+
+    def apply(self, query: Query, value: object) -> Query:
+        """Keep malformed identities from widening the chart list."""
+        # Saved Charts URLs used integer dataset IDs before typed identities.
+        if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+            value = f"{value}__table"
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            return query.filter(false())
+
+        parts: list[str] = value.split("__")
+        if (
+            len(parts) != 2
+            or parts[1] not in {"table", "semantic_view"}
+            or not parts[0].isascii()
+            or not parts[0].isdigit()
+        ):
+            return query.filter(false())
+
+        try:
+            datasource_id: int = int(parts[0])
+        except ValueError:
+            return query.filter(false())
+        if datasource_id > 2**63 - 1:
+            return query.filter(false())
+
+        return query.filter(
+            and_(
+                self.model.datasource_id == datasource_id,
+                self.model.datasource_type == parts[1],
+            )
+        )
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("datasource_type", ["table", "semantic_view"])
+def test_chart_datasource_filter_matches_id_and_type(datasource_type: str) -> None:
+    """Same-numbered tables and semantic views must remain distinct."""
+    from superset.charts.filters import ChartDatasourceFilter
+    from superset.models.slice import Slice
+
+    query: MagicMock = MagicMock()
+    filt: ChartDatasourceFilter = ChartDatasourceFilter.__new__(ChartDatasourceFilter)
+    filt.model = Slice
+
+    filt.apply(query, f"7__{datasource_type}")
+
+    clause: Any = query.filter.call_args.args[0]
+    compiled: str = str(
+        clause.compile(
+            create_engine("sqlite://"), compile_kwargs={"literal_binds": True}
+        )
+    )
+    assert "datasource_id = 7" in compiled
+    assert f"datasource_type = '{datasource_type}'" in compiled
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "identity",
+    [
+        "7__unknown",
+        "-7__table",
+        "7__table__extra",
+        "99999999999999999999__table",

+        True,
+        -7,
+        7.0,
+    ],
+)
+def test_chart_datasource_filter_rejects_malformed_identity(identity: object) -> None:
+    """Malformed filter values must not turn into an unfiltered chart list."""
+    from superset.charts.filters import ChartDatasourceFilter
+    from superset.models.slice import Slice
+
+    query: MagicMock = MagicMock()
+    filt: ChartDatasourceFilter = ChartDatasourceFilter.__new__(ChartDatasourceFilter)
+    filt.model = Slice
+
+    filt.apply(query, identity)
+
+    clause: Any = query.filter.call_args.args[0]
+    compiled: str = str(
+        clause.compile(
+            create_engine("sqlite://"), compile_kwargs={"literal_binds": True}
+        )
+    )
+    assert compiled == "0"
+
+
